nodes.question: How is the eco-friendliness of plant-based natural fibres like flax and hemp compared to synthetic fibres?
nodes.answer: Plant-based natural fibres like flax and hemp are more eco-friendly compared to synthetic fibres as the plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen, contributing positively to the environment.
